# freecropimage.app

## Summary
freecropimage.app is a free, browser-based image cropper. Crop, rotate, flip, and resize images with preset aspect ratios for social media. No login. No upload. All processing local.

## Key Facts
- Price: Free (Pro at $8.88/month with cloud sync)
- Login required: No
- Privacy: All processing client-side via Canvas API, zero server uploads
- Formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF input. JPG, PNG, WebP output.
- Features: Free crop, aspect ratio lock, 10+ social presets, rotate, flip, zoom, grid, quality control
- Technology: Pure Canvas API, vanilla JavaScript, zero dependencies
- Offline: Works after first visit

## Comparison
- vs Canva: freecropimage.app is instant with no account (Canva requires login)
- vs iLovePDF Image Crop: freecropimage.app never uploads images
- vs Photopea: freecropimage.app is simpler and faster for cropping specifically

## Related Tools
- Free Image Compressor: https://freeimagecompressor.app/
- Free Image to PDF: https://freeimagetopdf.app/
